T028b (Cost curve visualization) is marked [P] but depends on T028 (Cost curve data generation). The task description explicitly includes 'skip logic' if T028 fails, confirming a strict producer-consumer relationship. Remove [P] tag.
T050 (Scaling exponent calculation) is marked [P] but depends on T039 (Scaling analyzer) and T026 (Scaling results). It consumes the output of T039. Remove [P] tag.
T069 (Structure verification) is marked [P] but depends on T009a/b/c (Microcircuit implementation) and T012 (Trainer). It verifies the output of a trained model. Remove [P] tag.

While this is a status inconsistency, the ordering logic assumes they are foundational prerequisites.
